meta.name: x-article-publisher
meta.description: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文章发布到 X 并自动排版
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写 Markdown 并想一键发布到 X 文章。
copy.tagline_en: Publish Markdown articles to X with auto formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write in Markdown and want to publish to X Articles in one click.

howto.what: 将 Markdown 文章发布为 X (Twitter) Articles 草稿：解析标题、正文与图片，保留格式；缺少标题或封面时生成标题或提示生成封面；不会自动发布。
howto.when: 当用户提供 Markdown 文件或 URL 并要求发布到 X Articles，或提及“发布到 X”“发推文文章”“X article”等时触发。需已配置 X Premium Plus 并完成一次性认证。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 文章发布到 X
say.note: 会解析文章并打开 X Articles 编辑器保存草稿。

say.text: 将 /path/to/article.md 作为 X 文章草稿
say.note: 自动填写标题和内容，保存为草稿。

howto.what_en: Publishes Markdown articles to the X (Twitter) Articles editor, automatically parsing title, body, and images, preserving formatting as a draft; never auto-publishes, and cover image requires user confirmation or manual upload.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user provides a Markdown file or URL to publish to X Articles, or mentions 'publish to X', 'post article to Twitter', 'X article', etc. Requires X Premium Plus and one-time authentication.

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown article to X.
say_en.note: It will parse the article and open X Articles editor to save a draft.

say_en.text: Save /path/to/article.md as an X article draft.
say_en.note: It will fill title and content automatically, then save as draft.
